description: This file provides extensions and utility functions for the Date object, including formatting, parsing, and localization features. It appears to be part of the Datejs library, tailored for date manipulation and string representation.

methods.name: normalizeFormat
methods.description: Normalizes a date format string, resetting the internal format cache.

methods.name: strftime
methods.description: Formats a given timestamp according to a specified date format string.

methods.name: strtotime
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a date/time and returns the Unix timestamp.

methods.name: $format
methods.description: Formats a date object into a string based on the provided format string.
